utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve forgotten the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I’ll bring by the details when I have them, and we can figure out what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Rey — just bring whatever you have, and I’ll do my best to help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I’m listening; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m just checking who can help sort the donations and hand them out. If you’re free, I’d love you on the repair drive team.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can help with that — just point me to where to sort the donations, and I’ll do my best to hand them out too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Uli, what’s the latest on the repair drive? Do you need any help with it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina. I’m still sorting a few things out, but I’ll let you know if I need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure thing — just keep me posted, and if you need help hauling or sorting, I’m around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m Quinn, and I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to invite a few more neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please invite a few more neighbors. I’ll keep track of who can make it and where they’re coming from.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start with the folks on Maple and then check in with the folks near the park. I’ll send you their names and where they’re coming from as soon as they reply.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — could you bring a box cutter, packing tape, and a few markers? If you can also help sort donations by size when you arrive, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring a box cutter, packing tape, and markers, and I can help sort the donations by size when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you help sort the donated tools and make a quick sign-up list?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll sort the donated tools and make a quick sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m keeping the repair drive organized and warm, and I’ll make sure Bo has the latest details as soon as we set them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa — just send me the latest details when they’re set and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Bo — I’ll send the details as soon as they’re set and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing and where everything needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That makes sense—let’s keep it simple: I’ll send you the timing and drop-off spots first, then we can sort the rest out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me—send those details when you can, and I’ll plan around them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’d appreciate that. I’m mostly going off what I hear around the block, so any update helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list and make sure we’re stocked for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need and I’ll check what we have.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure you can keep track of it all? Just let me know what’s needed, and I’ll confirm what we still have.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll keep the list updated and flag anything we’re short on. Send me the needed items, and I’ll check what we have.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a huge help. I’ll make sure everyone knows you’re bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help, Jules — I’ll swing by with the tools and we’ll get things moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what do we need to know for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Faye — the main thing is we need folks after school pickup, and it’d help to keep the busiest jobs for late afternoon. I’ll spread the word and line up a simple sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can help steer people toward the late-afternoon slots and make sure we don’t overlap with pickup. Send me the sign-up sheet and I’ll share it with a few parents.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that—just tell me the date and time for the repair drive, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — I’ll check the final date and time and send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Jules — once you have it, send it over and I’ll make sure it fits around pickup and school hours.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get a date and time yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t seen a confirmed date or time yet—let me check the details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—please let me know as soon as you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on—nothing’s changed as far as I’ve heard. I’ll let you know if I catch any new details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — can you confirm the time if you hear it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized now, and I’d love your help if you’re up for it. We can make a simple list of what folks need and go from there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa, I’m happy to help. I’ll keep track of the supplies and start a simple list for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — that’s a big help. I’ll start collecting requests, and you can note the supplies as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep things low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — keep it low-key. If you can spare anything later, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll let you know when I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—do you know what they still need? I’m happy to help if there’s something small I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Nell—that’s really kind of you. I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact list, but I can check and let you know what small thing would help most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks. Just let me know when you find out, and I can swing by with whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what time is the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it starts in the afternoon, but I’d better check the exact time. If you can bring gloves or a box cutter, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can bring gloves and a box cutter. Just send me the exact time when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — could you help sort the donated tools and check which ones still need labels? That’d make the repair drive run a lot smoother.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and check which ones still need labels.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put you down for a spot or two?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—put me down for a spot or two. I’ve got some tools I can bring too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll put you down for a couple spots and note the tools too. Thanks, Gus—this drive’s going to go a lot smoother with your help!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—did I miss the repair drive sign-up details?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries — the sign-up table is by the community hall entrance, and they’re taking names until 6. I can walk you over if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. I’m headed over now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that’s good to hear — I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — if I spot anything useful, I’ll let you know.
